scripts.deploy: sh -c 'set -a && . .github/.env.ci && set +a && pnpm --filter @profiley/frontend build -- --mode=development && cd apps/frontend && pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name="$CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_PROJECT_DEV" --branch=main'
scripts.deploy:prod: sh -c 'set -a && . .github/.env.ci && set +a && pnpm --filter @profiley/frontend build -- --mode=production && cd apps/frontend && pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name="$CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_PROJECT_PROD" --branch=main'
